label: Connection density
subgoals: Divide one millimetre by the pitch
Square it for connections per square millimetre
Multiply by the bonded area for the total

label: Gain over microbumps
subgoals: Divide the microbump pitch by the hybrid pitch
Square the ratio for the density gain
Separate density gain from bandwidth gain

label: Overlay and pad overlap
subgoals: Subtract each offset from the pad side
Multiply and divide by the pad area
Relate the overlap to resistance and shorting risk
